title: Iran needs predictable rules, less red tape to strengthen foreign trade, industry group says

title: Iran’s largest oil processing plant reaches 320,000 bpd capacity at South Azadegan field
body: TEHRAN (IRNA) — Iran’s South Azadegan oil processing center has reached its nominal capacity of 320,000 barrels per day following the completion and commissioning of all four processing trains, state-owned Petropars Group said.

title: Iran sports minister Donyamali hails Iranian participants at 2026 Nagoya
body: TEHRAN - Iran’s Minister of Sports and Youth, Ahmad Donyamali, issued a message praising the Iranian delegation’s participation and efforts at the fifth edition of the Asian Para Games in Nagoya and congratulating the medal winners.

title: Snyder hopes to finally face Yazdani in Astana
body: TEHRAN - Kyle Snyder has never faced Hassan Yazdani in an official match, given that the two superstars have built their individual legends in disparate weight classes.
